class.name: FluidSynth
class.brief_description: Plays MIDI files using FluidSynth software synthesizer with SoundFont support.
class.description:
FluidSynth extends Node to provide MIDI playback capabilities using the FluidSynth library. It loads MIDI files and SoundFonts as custom resources (MidiFileReader and SoundFontFileReader) and synthesizes audio in real-time.
The player uses an AudioStreamGenerator internally to push synthesized audio frames to Godot's audio server.

method.name: fluidsynth_play
method.description: Starts or restarts MIDI playback using the currently loaded SoundFont and MIDI file. This is called automatically when the player starts (if autoplay is enabled), but can be called manually to restart playback.

method.name: set_soundfont
method.description: Sets the SoundFont to use for playback. The path should point to a .sf2str resource file created by the SoundFont importer.

method.name: get_soundfont
method.description: Returns the path to the currently loaded SoundFont resource.

method.name: set_midi_file
method.description: Sets the MIDI file to play. The path should point to a .midstr resource file created by the MIDI importer.

method.name: get_midi_file
method.description: Returns the path to the currently loaded MIDI file resource.

method.name: program_select
method.description: Selects a program (instrument) for a MIDI channel. [param channel] MIDI channel (0-15) [param bank_num] Bank number (0-16383) [param preset_num] Preset number (0-127)

method.name: note_on
method.description: Triggers a note-on event on the specified channel. [param channel] MIDI channel (0-15) [param key] MIDI note number (0-127) [param velocity] Note velocity (0-127)

method.name: note_off
method.description: Triggers a note-off event on the specified channel. [param channel] MIDI channel (0-15) [param key] MIDI note number (0-127)

method.name: pitch_bend
method.description: Sets the pitch bend value for a MIDI channel. [param channel] MIDI channel (0-15) [param value] Pitch bend value (0-16383, with 8192 being center/no bend)

members.member: Path to the SoundFont resource (.sf2str file) to use for synthesis. The SoundFont must be imported as a SoundFontFileReader resource.
Path to the MIDI file resource (.midstr file) to play. The MIDI file must be imported as a MidiFileReader resource.
